lines.text: Eleven at night. Forty seven customers waiting, three experts online, twelve offline and nobody told them.
A two-sided, on-demand marketplace for live expert sessions. Mental health, coaching, astrology. Three million downloads, three hundred experts.
No mechanism for a demand spike. The queue compounds, customers drop out, and the platform absorbs the cost.
Expert supply is inelastic. You cannot surge price a credential. But nobody asked those twelve.
So I designed Equilibrium. Five modules: demand signals, health scoring, surge pricing, incentive engine, AI routing.
Delay and dropout rate trigger it. Surge revenue is ring fenced to fund the bonus, so the response is self financing.
Peak queue down forty eight percent. Delay halved. Net platform cost, forty dollars.
Every module is live. Go and drive it.
